note: Fountain County, IN publishes its zoning map only as a PDF document (Document Center id=211). Its GIS offering is the Schneider Beacon parcel viewer, which returned 403 to our tools and has no zoning layer. No ArcGIS REST zoning districts service for the county or its cities (Attica, Covington, Veedersburg) was found in ArcGIS Hub/Online or web search; the city zoning pages list only ordinances and paper zone maps.
